body: {"summary":"JFrog Artifactory now integrates natively with Google Cloud’s Artifact Registry, allowing Cloud Run and Google Kubernetes Engine to pull container images directly from JFrog.","category":"partnership","themes":[],"entities":["JFrog Artifactory","Artifact Registry","Google Cloud","Cloud Run","Google Kubernetes Engine"],"numbers":[],"quote":"The missing piece has been getting Google Cloud’s own runtime services — like Cloud Run and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) — to pull directly from JFrog for every container image pull."}
